subject: release candidate acceptance on a real host

openui.note: the copy control renders its payload in full; the refused action renders a control rather than nothing

refusedActionFeedback.noticeText: @OpenUrl is not available in this build
refusedActionFeedback.why: the stage-5 fix: pressing a refused-action Button used to do nothing, with the reason only in a diagnostics array no user can read

htmlBackend.note: every HTML card iframe carries a sandbox attribute; the count equals frames, so none is unsandboxed

theme.note: the tokens differ between schemes, so this is a real switch rather than a renamed attribute

stateStorage.note: card state is keyed per session and per card path, which is what isolates two cards

probeDefectsFound: the first fixture used Heading, which openui-lang does not declare; the host answered VZO002 correctly and the fixture was wrong, not the product. The validator naming the unknown component is the behaviour working.
session start takes no --policy flag; the policy is negotiated by cooperate sync
navigate needs --context and --observation from a strict sync, and a session cannot change policy after creation
reading the clipboard with navigator.clipboard.readText() from a script never settles without a user activation; the OS clipboard was read instead, see the 4B evidence
notVerified: reload-and-restore was attempted three times and each attempt lost the CDP session to a page still settling. What is recorded instead is that state is persisted to localStorage under a per-session, per-card key. The restore path is covered by unit tests but not by this browser run.
the HTML backend was confirmed sandboxed and counted, but its rendered content was not inspected beyond the frame count
